Non-negative 2D extent [width height]. Entity: Vector2D (f510). Basis: [AxisHorizRight (f530) AxisVertDown (f531)]. Origin: None (origin-independent). These are metadata relationships rather than a Dc payload sequence.

Non-negative 3D extent [width height depth]. Entity: Vector3D (f511). Basis: [AxisHorizRight (f530) AxisVertDown (f531) AxisDepthIn (f533)]. Origin: None. These are metadata relationships rather than a Dc payload sequence.

Standard 2D Cartesian coordinate [x y]. Entity: Point2D (f506). Origin: Center (f528) or BottomLeft (f527). Axes: [AxisHorizRight (f530; +x right) AxisVertUp (f532; +y up)]. Order: OrderXY (f539). Typical use: math graphs PostScript/PDF CAD. These are metadata relationships rather than a Dc payload sequence.

Standard 3D Cartesian coordinate [x y z]. Entity: Point3D (f507). Origin: Center (f528). Axes: [AxisHorizRight (f530) AxisVertUp (f532) AxisDepthOut (f534)]. Order: OrderXYZ (f541). These are metadata relationships rather than a Dc payload sequence.

2D screen or window coordinate [x y]. Entity: Point2D (f506). Origin: WindowTopLeft (f526) or ScreenTopLeft (f525). Axes: [AxisHorizRight (f530; +x right) AxisVertDown (f531; +y down)]. Order: OrderXY (f539). Typical use: modern UI mouse/touch positions Wayland/X11 DOM clientX/Y. These are metadata relationships rather than a Dc payload sequence.

Modern 2D screen layout rectangle [x y width height]. Entity: Box2D (f513). Defined as anchor point ScreenPoint2D (f521) [x y] + extent vector Size2D (f517) [width height]. Origin: WindowTopLeft (f526). Typical use: CSS bounding rect window layout. These are metadata relationships rather than a Dc payload sequence.

Classic Mac OS QuickDraw point [v h]. Entity: Point2D (f506). Origin: WindowTopLeft (f526) or ScreenTopLeft (f525). Axes: [AxisVertDown (f531; +v down) AxisHorizRight (f530; +h right)]. Order: OrderVH (f540; vertical first horizontal second). Unit: QuickDraw points. Typical use: FinderInfo location (v h) QuickDraw Point. These are metadata relationships rather than a Dc payload sequence.
